criterion: which type of entity the encyclopedia article describes

categories.name: Vehicles
categories.definition: Machines or vessels designed for transportation on land, water, or air, including cars, ships, aircraft, and trains.

categories.name: Buildings and Structures
categories.definition: Man-made constructions such as houses, churches, schools, hospitals, and historic buildings.

categories.name: Biological Organisms
categories.definition: Living entities including species of animals, plants, fungi, and microorganisms, or biological genera.

categories.name: Educational Institutions
categories.definition: Schools, universities, colleges, and other organizations dedicated to teaching and learning.

categories.name: Companies and Organizations
categories.definition: Business entities, corporations, non-profit organizations, and other collective groups formed for commercial or social purposes.

categories.name: Geographical Features
categories.definition: Natural or artificial features of the Earth's surface, including mountains, rivers, lakes, and islands.

categories.name: Creative Works
categories.definition: Artistic and intellectual productions such as films, books, music albums, novels, and comics.

categories.name: People
categories.definition: Individual human beings, including politicians, athletes, artists, writers, and other notable figures.

categories.name: Periodicals
categories.definition: Publications issued at regular intervals, such as newspapers, academic journals, and magazines.

categories.name: Settlements
categories.definition: Human habitations such as cities, towns, villages, and hamlets.

categories.name: Albums
categories.definition: Collections of audio recordings, typically music, released as a single item.

categories.name: Books
categories.definition: Written or printed works of fiction or non-fiction, including novels and biographies.
